 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018  ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri K. L. Pandya appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.

Today, Mr. J. A. Salunke, Food Safety Officer (I.D.Card No. 14794, issued by Surat Municipal Corporation) is present before this Court stating that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court, and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, let the matter be disposed of.

Mr. Salunke states that the original complainant-Ranjitlal Umeshchand Shah, Food Inspector has retired from the services and he has been authorized by the designated officer and on this behalf, a letter of authority has been issued in his favour to remain present R/CR.RA/420/2017 ORDER before this Court.
The said letter of authority issued by the designated officer, Surat Municipal Corporatino as well as withdrawal/settlement pursis is taken on record.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

sentences.text: As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order 2nd May 2017 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution, implementation and operation of the impugned judgment dated 3rd May 2005 passed by the learned J.M.F.C.
(Municipal Court), Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 3 of 1998, which was confirmed by the learned 11th Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 20 of 2005 dated 28.04.2017 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High R/CR.RA/420/2017 ORDER Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.

The judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 3rd May 2005 passed by the learned J.M.F.C. (Municipal Court), Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 3 of 1998, which was confirmed by the learned 11th Additional Sessions Judge, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 20 of 2005 dated 28.04.2017 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/=
[Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
Bail bonds stand cancelled.
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.

It is required to be mentioned here that disposal of this matter will not in any way affect any connected cases arising out of the same, incident or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this Order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.
